subject: Request: GTM Strategic Priority Seats – Q3 Fast-Track Approval
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: GTM Strategic Priority Seats – Q3 Fast-Track Approval

Hi Lauren + Karthik —

This thread is to request fast-track approval for a small, targeted GTM headcount package we believe is critical to close a set of high-velocity expansion opportunities in Q3. Summary ask (details in attached spreadsheet):

- 3 Enterprise AEs (quota-bearing) — priority markets: Mid-Market West + Strategic Accounts
- 1 Senior Solutions Engineer (SE) — supports the three AE hires and two existing AE teams for complex demos/proofs
- 1 Customer Success Manager (CSM) — for onboarding/expansion on two large renewals expected in Aug–Sep

Rationale (short):
- Combined pipeline tied to these hires is ~ $4.8M ARR (conservative coverage) with a projected close window Jul–Sep.
- Several deals are timing-constrained (Atlas Systems, Beacon Health) and require additional bench SE capacity to run POCs in parallel.
- We are proposing an accelerated interview to offer timeline for AEs/SE: 2 weeks to offer if approved.

Budget/comp notes: comp bands mostly align to existing ranges. We have one exception request for a senior SE above the standard band by ~8% due to cross-functional skills and immediate impact. Attached: Q3-GTM-HC-ask.xlsx and comp-band-exception-form.pdf.

Requested decision deadline: COB Tues, May 11 to keep talent pipeline warm.

Ask: Lauren — approval to proceed with the hires and SE comp-band exception (if finance signs off). Karthik — confirmation on interview/resourcing support and any ops constraints. Monica — finance impact and whether we can fund these seats from the Q3 go-to-market reserve or if reallocation is needed.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
VP, West Sales | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: Q3-GTM-HC-ask.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: comp-band-exception-form.pdf (PDF stub)

Sean —

Thanks for the summary and the attachment. Quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:
1) Do the AE roles require relocation or are they remote? (affects comp bands)
2) The senior SE exception — can you give two bullets on why that candidate profile can’t be achieved inside band?
3) If we approve these 5 seats, do we have runway in the Q3 OPEX plan or do we need to pull from the GTM reserve?

Monica — tagging you for the budget/forecast callout. Karthik — please confirm 1) ability to run compressed interview lanes and 2) ramp support (SPOC for hiring ops).

If we can get answers by Mon 10am PT, I’ll move to approve conditionally.

-Lauren
SVP, Head of GTM Strategy

Subject: Re: Request: GTM Strategic Priority Seats – Q3 Fast-Track Approval

Hi all —

I reviewed the spreadsheet and ran the preliminary run-rate impact. High-level:
- All five seats can be funded from the GTM reserve pool for Q3 if hiring occurs before July payroll cutoff. That will consume ~62% of the current reserve.
- Net cashflow impact to Q3 OPEX is manageable but will reduce flexibility for discretionary hiring later in the quarter.
- SE comp-band exception: we can approve a one-time market adjustment for the senior SE role (up to 8%) provided a comp-exception form is filed (attached) and signoff from People Ops is obtained. We will also require a documented business case that proves a <9-month payback via pipeline coverage (your $4.8M ARR figure supports this).

Next steps from finance: please confirm exact start dates and hiring cadence so we can schedule budget reforecast. If Lauren signs off conditionally, I will prepare the finance release and route the comp-exception to People Ops.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
